physics.material_scope: Declared engineering assumptions, not material measurements

coordinate_frame: Workstation metres, +X east, +Y north, +Z up; radians; wxyz quaternions
rules: Build the entire single right-pointing rocket reference, including background cells, one released cube per pixel.

Cube side is 100 mm and common cell-center pitch is 126 mm. L1 has 125 mm clear square pockets, L2 printed lines, L3 no visible grid. The reference is north-up, centered on the declared assembly origin.
Stock allocations do not restrict which robot can use an item. Preserve completed placements and account for finger release/withdrawal clearance.
Only robot actuators and real contacts may affect the live task. No hand welds, object state writes, resets, hidden state tools or runtime physics edits.
objective: Complete the declared assembly/transport task correctly and efficiently; allocation, local motion and collaboration are Agent choices.

completion.scope: Mechanism-specific commissioning required; no inherited v1 evaluator assumed
